name: mt5-chart-browser
description: MT5 chart browser, pair scanner, indicator engine, and GPU-accelerated chart image analysis. Use this skill whenever the user asks to open MT5, browse pairs, view charts, apply indicators, screenshot charts, analyze chart images, read candlestick patterns from screenshots, scan multiple pairs visually, or perform any visual/technical analysis on MT5 charts. Also trigger when the user says "open MT5", "show me EURUSD", "what does the chart look like", "analyze this chart", "scan all pairs", "apply RSI", "screenshot the chart", "GPU analysis", "image recognition on chart", "read the candles", "what pattern is this", or any variation involving MT5 visual/chart interaction. This skill works with the trading-brain as a sub-agent for chart data acquisition.
